name: Flight Master Aviation Data MCP
tagline: Professional flight status, weather, delay risk, and trajectory data for AI agents
description: Official aviation data MCP by Flight Master DAST (航班管家 DAST). Provides flight status, route flight search, onboard experience, future delay and cancellation risk, hourly airport weather forecasts, and real-time or historical flight trajectories through the Model Context Protocol.

install.notes: A Flight Master DAST API Key is required. Create one at https://dast.133.cn and replace <DAST_API_KEY> with your key. The server uses Streamable HTTP.
